scope: Consolidation requires Code; Research optionally uses Consolidation and new no-code cycles finish after reflection approval

dependencies.consolidation: Code is mandatory; provider and adapters suspend when Code unloads
dependencies.research: Consolidation is an optional child injection; Research survives its unload

behavior.none: Approved reflection advances directly to complete without a Consolidation child
behavior.git: Approved reflection advances to Git consolidation; missing Consolidation produces a 409 workflow blocker and leaves the cycle unchanged
behavior.existingVersion2: Original graph and report-only/Git semantics retained, including stored request receipts
behavior.version1: Historical records remain readable; unsupported advancement is explicitly rejected

validation.architecture: interactive inventory regenerated; exact required/optional edge sets validated; static image visually checked

coverage: Server startup with Code disabled and Consolidation pending
No-code research cycle completes an independently reviewed reflection without Code
Leased reflection worker can read live research evidence without Code
Two Code unload/reload cycles preserve Research, Experiments, Knowledge and non-Git sessions
Consolidation tools withdraw while its provider is unavailable
Git research guidance reports a missing-provider blocker
Same handoff request succeeds after Code reload with exactly one child
Committed handoff replay succeeds while the child provider is absent
Persisted version-2 report-only cycle continues across restart and replay
limits: Existing standalone report-only Consolidation workflows and tool inputs remain supported for compatibility. New version-3 Research cycles never create that redundant stage. Verification uses local integration fixtures; no production records were rewritten.
